DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTS THISDECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTS (this “Declaration"), made as of the i day of _Seot . ,2014,byALCHIMEDIA, LTD., having an address at 114 Henry Street, Brooklyn, New York 1121I ("Declarant"). 11201 WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Declarant is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, Kings County, City and State of NewYork,known as Lot 47in Block 1952 on the Tax Map ofthe City of NewYork,and as and by the street address 279 Greene Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11238,and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the“Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Declarant also is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, if any, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, Kings County,City and State of New York, known as Lot 48 in Block 1952 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 277 Greene Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11238, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the“Developer Land").
